body:
Founder real-time: unify windows (canonical) + TS animation, dogfood PARENA more. apps/gui/fx.c refactored to CALL new PARENA-generated core/fx_rules.c instead of hand-deriving scenario/timeline logic -- real consumer now, not parallel implementation. New web/src/fx.ts renders the same decisions with Canvas2D+WebAudio, wired into main.ts. New tests/test_fx_rules.c (4092 checks vs independent oracle). scripts/build.sh --gui stays fully green (zero regression). Browser side verified against a real live match (9/9 rounds, e2e_test.mjs). Honest gaps: Canvas rendering never opened in a real browser (no display here); energy-delta/status visuals not wired (ROUND_RESULT lacks those fields). Commit 1357298.

⚓ ☃
title: Unified Windows + browser round-resolution animation/audio via PARENA
